chosen.premise: The faster Rapidash runs, the longer its mane’s flames become, turning speed into a visible transformation.
chosen.hook: Rapidash’s mane gets longer the faster it runs.
chosen.visualIdea: Rapidash accelerates across three shots as its flaming mane visibly stretches and blazes brighter.
chosen.note: Very Rapidash-specific and visually excellent, with multiple entries connecting speed to the mane, though 'longer' is harder to depict precisely than a number.

candidates.premise: Rapidash reaches 150 mph from a standstill after running just 10 steps.
candidates.hook: Rapidash hits 150 miles per hour in only ten steps.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Rapidash taking ten numbered steps as a speedometer rockets from zero to 150 mph.
candidates.note: A highly concrete, startling mechanic with direct Pokédex support from multiple entries and an easy ten-step speedometer visual.

candidates.premise: Regular Rapidash is Fire-type and weighs 95 kg, while its Galar variety is Psychic/Fairy and weighs 80 kg.
candidates.hook: Rapidash can change from a 95-kilo Fire horse into an 80-kilo Psychic/Fairy one.
candidates.visualIdea: Place the two Rapidash forms side by side with their types and weights appearing like comparison cards.
candidates.note: Accurate and easy to compare on screen, but regional-form comparisons are a common Pokémon format and the weight difference is not especially dramatic.

candidates.premise: Rapidash is so competitive that seeing anything faster makes it chase at top speed.
candidates.hook: The one thing guaranteed to trigger Rapidash? Something faster than it.
candidates.visualIdea: A faster target flashes past Rapidash; its expression changes before it launches into pursuit.
candidates.note: Strongly supported behavioral contradiction: a Pokémon defined by speed still compulsively chases anything faster, but the hook is less numerically sharp.

candidates.premise: In Rapidash’s herd, the fastest runner becomes leader and controls the group’s pace and direction.
candidates.hook: For Rapidash, the fastest runner gets to lead the entire herd.
candidates.visualIdea: Several Rapidash run together while the fastest moves to the front and redirects the herd.
candidates.note: A distinctive social rule backed by one entry, though the single-source premise is less robust and the visual is comparatively generic.

candidates.premise: Rapidash’s evolution is a level-40 transformation from Ponyta, keeping the same Fire typing.
candidates.hook: Rapidash does not evolve early—it waits until level 40.
candidates.visualIdea: A level counter climbs to 40 before Ponyta flashes into Rapidash, with Fire remaining on screen.
candidates.note: Concrete and well suited to gameplay visuals, but level-40 evolution is not especially surprising or unique, and the evolution method relies on secondary research.
